visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long dark hair in a white ruffled blouse holds two multi-colored cardboard swatches up to another woman seated in a chair. The seated woman has a grey cutout frame positioned around her face, displaying various color palettes. They are in a brightly lit studio with a mirror and shelves of makeup behind them. (2) A physical document is shown on a table, featuring diagrams of a human body silhouette and various Chinese text notations, presumably for analysis. (3) A group of about six women are seen sitting at long tables in a workshop-style setting, examining colored materials and papers under bright overhead lights. (4) An exterior shot shows a pink standing sign on a sidewalk with the text 'LAVIEENSU' and social media handles. This is followed by a shot of a white corner building with vertical black banners reading 'All About Me' and 'LAVIEENSU'. (5) Back indoors, a woman's hand uses a small white electronic sensor device against the cheek of the seated woman. They then look at a printed chart featuring numerous squares of skin-tone shades and foundation colors. (6) Close-up shots show numerous clear acrylic organizers filled with lipsticks, lip tints, and eyeshadow palettes. A hand pulls a drawer containing a pink blush and several small bottles. (7) A stylist points to a large seasonal color chart labeled Spring, Summer, Autumn, and Winter, with various makeup items placed on the respective colored squares to demonstrate suitability. (8) The stylist drapes different colored fabric pieces—ranging from soft pastels to deep blues—over the seated woman's shoulders while she looks into a lit vanity mirror. A small handheld color wheel is also used for comparison. The stylist then uses a brush to apply makeup to the seated woman's face. (9) A wide shot of the studio reveals racks of colorful fabric drapes, mirrors, and various beauty products. (10) A series of mobile phone screenshots are displayed, showing detailed analysis results including body shape diagrams, nail art styles, hairstyles, outfit combinations, and glasses frames. (11) Two women sit at a desk reviewing a document together. The scene then cuts back to the makeup application process. (12) Several clear glass bottles containing colorful liquids (essential oils or perfumes) are arranged on a counter. The woman smells a small blue bottle, and finally, a finished perfume bottle with a 'LAVIEENSU' label is held up. (13) A group of four women are seen in a blurred background, jumping and cheering. The video ends with a shot of the building's exterior and a display of makeup products on a counter.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Service Experience -> Results/Analysis -> Promotional Info -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase a comprehensive personal color analysis and makeup service in Busan, Korea, highlighting the various diagnostic steps (skin tone, color draping, body shape) and results, while promoting an upcoming workshop in Taiwan and offering a discount to viewers.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video explicitly names and shows the location of 'LAVIEENSU', provides social media handles, and includes a call to action for a giveaway and workshop enrollment.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively uses fast-paced editing and text overlays to deliver a high density of information about a beauty service. The mix of real-world experience and digital results screenshots creates a persuasive narrative for the service's value.
